title: the map backgeound shall expand below the chat input

messages.content: the map backgeound shall expand below the chat input

Done. The change makes the map view float the composer on top of the galaxy iframe instead of sitting below it.

**What I changed** (`crs-brain/public/index.html`):
- Added `id="centerCol"` to the center column.
- New CSS: in `.map-mode`, `.composer-wrap` becomes `position:absolute; bottom:0; background:transparent`. That frees its space so the `flex:1` content area (and the map iframe inside it) expands to the bottom of the column — the galaxy now renders **behind and below** the composer. `pointer-events` is off on the padding and back on for the composer itself, so clicks in the empty area still reach the map.
- Toggle the `map-mode` class: added in `showMap()`, removed in `showChat()`, `showDashboard()`, and `openFile()`.

The composer stays a solid pill (its `var(--panel)` background) floating over the starfield, so it's still readable with no seam. Reload the app on the Map view to see it.
